eyebrow.zh: 华为云 · 国际产品简介

subtitle.zh: 面向全球研发团队的 AI 软件交付助手：从意图到可合并变更，缩短交付路径。
subtitle.en: An AI software-delivery assistant for global engineering teams—from intent to merge-ready change, with less SDLC friction.

notes.zh: 开场强调国际买家语境：研发效能、工具链协同、企业可控；不谈未核实的价格与 SLA。
notes.en: Open on overseas buyer context: engineering productivity, toolchain fit, and enterprise control—no unverified price or SLA claims.

subtitle.zh: 一条紧凑的销售叙事：价值 → 方式 → 对照 → 下一步。
subtitle.en: A tight sales arc: value → how it works → contrast → next step.

notes.zh: 高管精简切面会隐藏本页；完整版用于发现会开场对齐。
notes.en: Hidden on the executive cut; use the full deck to align discovery workshops.

label.zh: 下一步：发现会 / PoC 范围

subtitle.zh: 用可验证的交付结果说话；区域合规与容量请以正式材料为准。
subtitle.en: Speak in verifiable delivery outcomes; treat region-specific compliance and capacity as confirm-with-marketing.

notes.zh: 三张卡片对应速度、在岗体验、治理姿态；避免承诺具体加速百分比。
notes.en: Three cards map to speed, in-flow experience, and governance posture; avoid inventing acceleration percentages.

body.zh: 在需求澄清、实现与评审环节提供 AI 辅助，帮助团队更快形成可审查、可合并的变更。
body.en: Assist clarification, implementation, and review so teams reach inspectable, merge-ready changes with less thrash.

body.zh: 围绕编码、评审与文档协同提供协助，减少在工具之间来回切换造成的上下文丢失。
body.en: Support coding, review, and documentation collaboration—reducing context loss from constant tool-switching.

body.zh: 按组织工作流与可控边界设计（权限、审计与团队协作约定以正式方案与部署区域为准）。
body.en: Designed for organizational workflows and controllable boundaries—permissions, auditability, and team conventions (confirm per formal proposal and deployment region).

subtitle.zh: 一条可讲解的协作闭环；具体集成清单以 PoC 范围为准。
subtitle.en: A presentable collaboration loop; treat concrete integrations as PoC-scoped.

notes.zh: 演示时按四步走：理解 → 规划 → 生成精炼 → 评审交接；不要展开内部模型细节。
notes.en: Walk four beats: understand → plan → generate & refine → review & handoff; avoid internal model detail.

body.zh: 把业务目标与约束转成可执行的研发任务描述。
body.en: Turn business goals and constraints into actionable engineering task framing.

body.zh: 形成步骤化方案，明确改动面与验收关注点。
body.en: Produce a step-wise plan with change surface and acceptance focus.

body.zh: 辅助实现与迭代，保持人类在环审查。
body.en: Assist implementation and iteration while keeping humans in the review loop.

body.zh: 沉淀可审查结果，进入团队既有合并与发布流程。
body.en: Land reviewable outcomes into the team's existing merge and release process.

result.zh: 结果：一条可对外讲解的 AI 辅助交付闭环——不替代研发责任，强化交付节奏。
result.en: Outcome: a briefable AI-assisted delivery loop—augmenting engineers, not replacing ownership.

subtitle.zh: 叙事对照，非基准测试；量化收益请在 PoC 中按客户基线测量。
subtitle.en: Narrative contrast—not a benchmark. Measure gains against the customer's baseline in a PoC.

notes.zh: 左侧讲碎片化与返工，右侧讲意图驱动与人类在环；不要编造加速百分比。
notes.en: Left = fragmentation and rework; right = intent-driven flow with humans in the loop—no invented acceleration %.

body.zh: 意图、实现与评审分散在多处工具与对话里，上下文反复丢失。
body.en: Intent, implementation, and review live across scattered tools and threads—context resets constantly.

bullets.zh: 需求澄清与编码脱节，返工成本高
bullets.en: Clarification and coding drift apart; rework cost stays high

bullets.zh: 评审材料不完整，合并前反复补洞
bullets.en: Incomplete review artifacts force last-mile patching before merge

bullets.zh: 治理靠人工追问，难形成可审计闭环
bullets.en: Governance relies on ad-hoc chase-downs instead of an auditable loop

body.zh: 从意图到可审查变更保持同一条讲解路径，人类仍掌握合并决策。
body.en: One briefable path from intent to inspectable change—humans keep the merge decision.

bullets.zh: 任务框架更清晰，改动面更早对齐
bullets.en: Clearer task framing; change surface aligned earlier

bullets.zh: 生成与精炼留在研发主路径，减少切换损耗
bullets.en: Generate-and-refine stays in the engineering flow; less switch cost

bullets.zh: 可审查结果进入既有合并与发布流程
bullets.en: Reviewable outcomes land in existing merge and release process

subtitle.zh: 按角色切换讲法；具体区域合规、集成清单与商务条款为占位—以正式方案为准。
subtitle.en: Switch the story by role. Region compliance, integration lists, and commercial terms are placeholders—confirm in the formal proposal.

notes.zh: 用页签切换 Engineering / Platform / Governance；高管精简切面隐藏本页。
notes.en: Tab through Engineering / Platform / Governance; hidden on the executive cut.

body.zh: 关注交付节奏与质量门禁：更少上下文切换，更快形成可合并变更，同时保留人工评审。
body.en: Care about cadence and quality gates: less context-switching, faster path to merge-ready change, humans still review.

bullets.zh: 把业务意图转成可执行任务框架
bullets.en: Turn business intent into actionable task framing

bullets.zh: 实现与评审协助留在研发主路径
bullets.en: Keep implementation and review assist inside the engineering flow

bullets.zh: [占位] 与现有 IDE / Git 工作流的对接范围在 PoC 中确认
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Confirm IDE / Git workflow fit inside PoC scope

body.zh: 关注可嵌入性与边界：Agent 应增强既有流水线，而不是另起一套影子流程。
body.en: Care about embeddability and boundaries: the agent should reinforce the existing pipeline—not spawn a shadow process.

bullets.zh: 围绕编码、评审与文档协同设计协助点
bullets.en: Assist points around coding, review, and documentation collaboration

bullets.zh: 结果交接回团队既有合并与发布路径
bullets.en: Handoff outcomes back into the team's merge and release path

bullets.zh: [占位] 具体集成清单与环境拓扑以 PoC 与架构评审为准
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Concrete integrations and topology confirmed in PoC / architecture review

body.zh: 关注可控边界与可审计姿态：权限、协作约定与区域合规需在正式材料中落定。
body.en: Care about controllable boundaries and audit posture: permissions, collaboration norms, and regional compliance land in formal materials.

bullets.zh: 按组织工作流设计，强调人类在环决策
bullets.en: Designed for organizational workflow with humans-in-the-loop decisions

bullets.zh: [占位] 部署区域、数据驻留与合规声明—确认产品市场与法务
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Deployment region, residency, and compliance statements—confirm with product marketing / legal

bullets.zh: [占位] 商务条款、容量与 SLA—不以本页承诺
bullets.en: [Placeholder] Commercial terms, capacity, and SLAs—not committed on this slide

vision.zh:
把数字世界带入每个人、每个家庭、
每个组织，构建万物互联的智能世界。
vision.en:
Bring digital to every person, home and organization
for a fully connected, intelligent world.

notes.zh: 收尾邀请下一步：发现会 / PoC 范围确认；价格与 SLA 不在本页承诺。
notes.en: Close with next step: discovery workshop or PoC scope confirmation—no price or SLA commitments on this slide.
